Arcanine Flare Blitz KOs Sinistcha ~80% at -1 Atk. Rotom Protect success rate reduced after consecutive use.

Game 2 plan: Lead Garchomp + Rotom-Wash to handle Metagross-Mega and Primarina. Rotom Charti Berry survives Goodra Draco Meteor. Arcanine + Blaziken back for Intimidate, Fire coverage, and Speed Boost sweep under TR. Blaziken can Swords Dance or Speed Boost to outspeed TR abusers. Watch for Farigiraf Trick Room turn 1 with Mental Herb.

decisions.rationale: Mega Metagross tough-claws offense without Trick Room dependency avoids Tinkaton FakeOut counter entirely. Metagross EQ 2HKOes Tinkaton and IcePunch OHKOes Garchomp; Primarina Moonblast threatens Blaziken; Sinistcha ShadowBall pressures Starmie; GoodraHisui FireBlast cleans Tinkaton. Mode works vs all likely opponent lines including Tinkaton+Starmie, Garchomp+Arcanine, and Blaziken variants.

reflections.summary: Blaziken's Speed Boost and overwhelming Fire-type coverage dismantled the opponent's bulky core after Rotom eliminated Primarina. The win was heavily aided by the opponent's poor defensive switches, such as sending a 15% HP Metagross into a double Fire-type onslaught.
reflections.adjustment: Fix the Team Preview read: if the opponent drops Farigiraf, they are not playing Trick Room. Abandon the anti-TR plan and do not bring Garchomp into a Metagross-Mega and Primarina lead; instead, tailor the lead to break their actual bulky balance core.
reflections.notebook: Opponent drops Farigiraf and Conkeldurr for a bulky balance core (Metagross-Mega, Primarina, Sinistcha, Goodra-Hisui). Opponent leads Metagross-Mega and Primarina. Metagross-Mega runs Ice Punch, Earthquake, Meteor Mash, Zen Headbutt. Primarina runs Life Orb, Torrent, Hydro Pump, Moonblast, Ice Beam. Sinistcha runs Sitrus Berry, Hospitality, Matcha Gotcha, Shadow Ball, Strength Sap, Protect. Goodra-Hisui runs Leftovers, Shell Armor, Flash Cannon, Draco Meteor, Fire Blast, Protect. Opponent heavily utilizes Protect on Sinistcha and Goodra-Hisui to stall for position. Opponent prefers switching out low-HP Metagross-Mega rather than sacrificing it.

reflections.summary: We lost because Rotom-Wash’s Volt Switch pivot outsped and KOed Primarina early, while Blaziken accumulated Speed boosts unchecked and swept with Close Combat and Flare Blitz. Our passive turn 2 switch-in gave the opponent free momentum, and we lacked speed control to halt Blaziken.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, lead with Metagross and Sinistcha to target Rotom with Ice Punch / Matcha Gotcha and threaten Arcanine with Ground/Grass coverage. Preserve Primarina for late-game against Blaziken after breaking its Focus Sash with double-ups or priority. Use Protect more judiciously on predicted Fire moves into Metagross/Sinistcha.
reflections.notebook: G2 opp brought Arcanine/Garchomp/Blaziken/Rotom. Garchomp fainted T1 to Ice Punch; Rotom Charti Berry, Volt Switch pivot; Arcanine Sitrus Intimidate, used Protect on predicted SE; Blaziken Focus Sash + Speed Boost swept after Primarina dropped. Opp likely to vary team G3: Starmie/Tinkaton may appear. Our G3 plan: lead Metagross + Sinistcha; Primarina + Goodra back. Pressure Rotom/Garchomp leads with Ice/Grass, catch Blaziken on switch, break Sash early.
